name: Liquidity run (BSL/SSL stop run)

definitions.definition_text: Liquidity refers to how quickly an asset can be bought/sold without dramatically affecting price. ICT interest focuses on where pending orders (buy stops above / sell-side below) reside; swing highs left behind imply buy-stop / buy-side liquidity above; polarity for lows.

source.title: ICT Mentorship Core Content - Month 1 - Liquidity Runs

definitions.definition_text: High resistance liquidity run: market must trade through thick prior highs/lows to reach stop liquidity above an old high (or below an old low) — least probable condition to seek; prefer not hunting these opportunities.
conditions: Many intervening swing highs/lows between price and target stop pool

source.title: ICT Mentorship Core Content - Month 1 - Liquidity Runs
